about: GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 3.05bpw on one RTX 3090 inside 55 GiB of host RAM: routed experts read with O_DIRECT from a packed NVMe store into an exclusive pinned RAM tier and an elastic GPU expert cache, AVX2 CPU lane for cold RAM-resident decode picks (glm53-flash-offload 7f1ee89, GLM53_MODE=nvme, campaign run N119 S3b2)
setup: NEEDS: 1x RTX 3090 24 GB (expert cache capped at 1,376 slots by GLM53_EC_MAX_SLOTS so a desktop on the same GPU cannot run the CUDA graphs out of memory); the container is capped at 55 GiB of host RAM (resources: --memory 55g --memory-swap 55g, swap off inside the cap; the RAM tier is sized from the cap: 4,831 experts = 42.5 GiB; memory.peak 51.1-51.3 GiB measured) and runs with --ulimit memlock=-1 (the RAM tier is cudaHostRegister'ed); an x86-64 CPU with AVX2+FMA+F16C and >= 40 logical CPUs: nv2 pins its threads to the measured layout (CPU lane 2-23, main thread 24, controller 25, 16 NVMe readers 26-39) when the container's CPUs hold it, else derives the layout from the container's CPU set and logs it (speed with a derived layout is not measured); disk: the 125.3 GB checkpoint (only its non-expert weights are read) plus the 117.3 GB packed expert store on a local NVMe filesystem that supports O_DIRECT (xfs, ext4), read at ~7 GB/s on average while serving (20.2 TB over the 46-minute S3b2 sweep; measured on 4x Samsung 9100 PRO md RAID0 xfs; one drive is not measured). PREPARE (once, CPU only): the image's `pack-store` packs the routed experts (42 layers x 288 x 9.44 MB) from the read-only checkpoint into /nvx/glm53_flash_exl3_3.05bpw_experts.bin + .json, re-reads every record with O_DIRECT and checks its sha256, and byte-compares a sample against the checkpoint; `verify-store` repeats the sha256 re-read (11 s on the measured array). pack-store, verify-store and the server first probe O_DIRECT on /nvx and stop with a one-line reason if the filesystem refuses it. Serving mounts /nvx read-only. MEASURED (README '55 GB NVMe mode', campaign arm S3b2, sweep.py --template glm --prefill 8192 32768 --conc 1 2 4, natural completions, EPYC 7443P, 503 GiB DDR4, PCIe 4.0 x16, driver 610.57): prefill 8k 583 / 32k 812 tok/s; decode C1 14.85, C2 15.62 agg, C4 16.27 agg, C1 at 32k 13.46 tok/s. Image smoke P003 of digest 82eef823 (repo 9269860, the same serving code) on a busier host (desktop stream on the GPU, a B70 job running): 545.3 / 767.4, decode 13.70 / 14.38 / 15.24, 32k C1 12.40; ready after 76 s. QUALITY: prefill / teacher-forced panel top-1 1.0000, KL 0 (2,154 positions); decode not exact (CPU lane): paired KL 0.0047 (p99 0.082), top-1 0.986; GLM53_MODE=nvme-exact is bit-exact at ~8.3 tok/s. Text only; OpenAI tool calls parsed from GLM's <tool_call> format. Raw: github.com/0xSero/glm53-flash-offload results/N119-S3b2-55g and results/P003-nvme-image-smoke.
